component.name: FluidVoice Linux
component.summary: Private, local voice dictation for KDE Plasma

description.p: FluidVoice Linux provides private local speech recognition, optional local or user-configured AI cleanup, a global hold-to-dictate shortcut, and Wayland-aware text delivery for KDE Plasma.

Adds conservative language-aware AI cleanup, deterministic preprocessing, model quality and privacy guidance, cleanup policy and language metadata in History exports, real controller module boundaries, responsive background I/O, consolidated runtime and delivery policies, hardened private storage and local-provider networking, expanded regression coverage, and complete release validation.

Adds privacy-safe audio history, configurable overlays, complete Write Mode, stronger Wayland delivery, automatic application profiles, advanced dictionary workflows, richer statistics, segmented meeting transcription, a secure loopback API, signed release archives, Arch packaging, a developer-preview Flatpak manifest, and an experimental local speech-server bridge.

Adds optional local and cloud AI enhancement, guided Ollama setup and model downloads, local-only privacy controls, streaming cleanup, application profiles, selected-text rewriting, safe Command Mode actions, richer history exports, and broad local audio decoding.
Adds Vulkan acceleration, KDE-aware appearance settings, upstream-style navigation, model management, and local productivity features.
Initial private preview with native KDE Wayland dictation, PipeWire capture, local Whisper transcription, and clipboard delivery.
